# SOP-P1-L1-01 Line startup - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03

Purpose
1. This procedure defines the standardized method to start the Hot Forge line for production readiness, focusing on safe energization, equipment verification, and attainment of target billet condition prior to forming operations.

Scope
2. Applies to operators, maintenance technicians, and line leads responsible for EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, and EQ-P1-L1-IH03 on P1-L1 only. Refer to MM-P1-L1-IH03 for maintenance records, SB-1009 for safety bulletin information, and SOP-P1-L1-03 for shutdown sequence.

Preconditions
3. Line area clear of nonessential personnel; permit-to-work closed for any open electrical or mechanical work. All lockout/tagout work orders must be returned and verified complete per plant LOTO practice. Machine guards and interlocks must be installed and functional. Control room operator must have clear line of sight or video feed of line entry points.

PPE
4. Required PPE: heat-resistant gloves, face shield with splash protection, safety glasses, hearing protection, steel-toe footwear, flame-resistant clothing. Verify PPE condition and certifications before entry into controlled hot zones around EQ-P1-L1-IH03 and forming stations.

Background and rationale
5. Proper startup reduces thermal gradients that cause billet distortion and reduces mechanical stress on EQ-P1-L1-RR01 mandrel and clamping systems. Preheat and staging minimize scrap and protect tooling. This SOP ensures the billet reaches specified metallurgical readiness and mechanical components are torqued to required specification to prevent slippage and fatigue failures during radial ring rolling.

Critical target parameters
6. The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C. Monitor and record the temperature readback from the EQ-P1-L1-IH03 control panel. Do not proceed to forming until the target reading is stable and within process tolerance defined in the heating system HMI.

7. The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 635 N·m. Use a calibrated torque wrench; log torque verification to the equipment maintenance record.

Step-by-step startup procedure
8. Visual and documentation check
   8.1 Verify that the daily prestart checklist is completed and signed by the shift lead.  
   8.2 Confirm there are no active maintenance tags on EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, or EQ-P1-L1-IH03.  
   8.3 Inspect emergency stops, light curtains, and guarding for correct operation.

9. Power and control verification
   9.1 Ensure main supply breakers are in the ready state per control room protocol.  
   9.2 Bring PLCs and HMIs online and verify communications to each equipment PLC. Check alarm logs for persistent faults and clear only those faults that are documented and resolved.

10. Mechanical readiness for EQ-P1-L1-RR01
   10.1 Inspect mandrel and clamp assembly for foreign material, wear, and lubricant condition.  
   10.2 Verify mandrel clamp bolt torque is 635 N·m. Record the measured torque values and the torque tool serial number in the maintenance log. If torque cannot be achieved, tag out and escalate to maintenance.

11. Conveyor and feeder checks for EQ-P1-L1-CN02
   11.1 Confirm conveyor tracking and belt integrity visually. Ensure sensors are aligned and clean. Verify feed position limits and speed command response in manual jog mode prior to automated feed.

12. Induction heater procedure for EQ-P1-L1-IH03
   12.1 Confirm refractory containment and cooling circuits are functional.  
   12.2 Engage heater controls in manual heat-up mode and observe ramp behavior on the EQ-P1-L1-IH03 HMI. Monitor for unusual noises or vibrations.  
   12.3 Wait for the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C. Log the time and temperature when target is reached and confirm stability before initiating feed.

13. Trial billet and process confirmation
   13.1 Load a trial billet and follow controlled feed to EQ-P1-L1-RR01 with operators in position. Observe material flow, mandrel engagement, and clamp behavior.  
   13.2 Inspect the trial part for dimensional fidelity and surface defects. Compare against the process acceptance criteria in operator work instructions.

14. Production enable
   14.1 If trial part meets acceptance criteria, enable automatic cycle and monitor the first production run.  
   14.2 Continue to sample parts at the frequency specified in the production control plan and log results.

Examples and rationale
15. Example record entry: "EQ-P1-L1-IH03 temp steady at 1180 °C as of 07:45; mandrel bolts torqued to 635 N·m; trial part passed visual and dimensional acceptance." Such entries provide traceability for thermal and mechanical readiness decisions.

Records to keep
16. Maintain the following records in the equipment folder and digital document control system:
   - Completed prestart checklist with signatures.  
   - Torque verification log showing mandrel clamp bolt torque for EQ-P1-L1-RR01 is 635 N·m.  
   - EQ-P1-L1-IH03 temperature log showing attainment of 1180 °C.  
   - Trial part inspection report and photos.  
   - Any alarms or faults encountered during startup and their corrective actions.

Deviation handling
17. If any parameter cannot be met (temperature, torque, interlock status), stop startup and log a deviation. Notify maintenance and line management. Follow MM-P1-L1-IH03 for maintenance escalation and SB-1009 for safety incident reporting.

Related documents
18. See MM-P1-L1-IH03, SB-1009, SOP-P1-L1-03 for maintenance, safety, and shutdown references.

Sign-off
19. Operator: ______________________ Date: ______________________  
20. Shift Lead: ____________________ Date: ______________________  
21. Maintenance Representative: ____________________ Date: ______________________

End of procedure.
